Brand Kit

Build with Agentivity.
Look the part.

Guidelines for using the Agentivity brand — logos, colours, typography and the rules that keep everything consistent.

Logo

Use the wordmark on its own. Never distort, recolour, or add effects. Maintain clear space equal to the height of the "A" on all sides.

White — on dark backgrounds
Dark — on light backgrounds
White — on brand colour
✓ Do
  • Use the official SVG files
  • Maintain proportions — never stretch
  • Use on solid, contrasting backgrounds
  • Allow generous clear space
✗ Don't
  • Recolour the logo
  • Add drop shadows, outlines or gradients
  • Place on busy or low-contrast backgrounds
  • Use at sizes below 120px wide

Colour System

Our palette is electric and intentional. Each colour has a defined role — don't swap them arbitrarily.

Red #FF0A30 --red Primary · CTAs · Accents
Violet #6D00F5 --violet Secondary · Links · Tags
Mint #00C896 --mint Synergi · Success
Cyan #00CFFF --cyan Topologies · Info
Navy #0D1B35 --navy Section backgrounds
Black #0A0F1E --black Hero · Dark sections
Pearl #F0F2FF --pearl Light section backgrounds
White #FFFFFF --white Base background
Brand Gradient linear-gradient(135deg, #FF0A30 0%, #6D00F5 100%) Used on key numbers, highlights and accents. Never on large backgrounds.

Typography

Two typefaces only. Inter for everything human. JetBrains Mono for everything technical.

Inter
Inter

Headings, body copy, UI labels. Weights used: 900 (display), 800 (h1–h2), 700 (h3, buttons), 400 (body).

Google Fonts ↗
JetBrains
Mono
JetBrains Mono

Eyebrows, labels, code, badges, metadata. Always uppercase for eyebrows. Weights: 700 (labels), 400 (code).

Google Fonts ↗

Tone of Voice

How Agentivity sounds — confident, human, direct. No jargon. No hype.

Direct

Say exactly what you mean. No padding, no weasel words. Short sentences win.

✓ "Your agents work while you sleep."
✗ "Leverage the power of AI-driven autonomous agent orchestration."
Human

Write like a smart colleague, not a press release. Use "you", not "the user".

✓ "You set the rules. Your team delivers."
✗ "Users can configure agent parameters to optimise workflow outputs."
Confident

We believe in this product. No hedging. State what Agentivity does, not what it "might" do.

✓ "15+ hours saved per week."
✗ "Potentially saving you significant amounts of time."
Unpretentious

No hype, no buzzwords. Business people are busy — respect their time.

✓ "Build your AI team. No code."
✗ "Revolutionising the paradigm of next-generation agentic intelligence."
